_meta.description: Post-race archival workflow. Triggered by Race Director at race end. Consolidates all telemetry, scores, gate events, and safety events. Posts immutable race summary to Algorand blockchain, archives full dataset to AWS S3 (10-year retention), and notifies AAMI to close the certification record.
_meta.trigger: Webhook POST /mrcp-race-end (manual trigger by Race Director)
